title: Ultimate: now its own repository, with a terminal and SSH/SFTP work
summary: Ultimate, my offline Android toolkit, has moved into its own standalone repository, and the latest merge adds a terminal, an orb and SSH/SFTP.
whyCare: It's the main thing I'm building right now, and the repository is public if you want to read how it's put together.
limitations: This is taken from the commit message and README. I haven't built or run the app, so I can't say how the new pieces behave on a phone.
